key_insight: Explainable deep reinforcement learning can optimize building energy management while making battery-control decisions understandable to users.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps residential buildings with PV and storage cut electricity costs under dynamic tariffs and uncertain demand, which supports practical deployment of smarter energy controllers.
method: Train on-policy and off-policy DRL agents for battery energy management
Use an expanded state space with demand, PV, battery, SoC, prices, weather, calendar, and forecasts
Apply post-hoc explainability methods to interpret learned control policies
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates both synthetic data and real-world LLEC data at KIT, and reports that A2C and PPO outperform off-policy methods in cumulative reward and policy stability.
watch_item: Explainability is post-hoc, so the interpretations may not fully capture the true internal reasoning of the DRL policy in unseen operating conditions.
paper_title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings
